say:3:1321129001:1.source_cn: 得、得救了……幸好有你们在……！

say:4:1321129002:1.source_cn: 你为什么要一个人跑出来呀？刚才真的太危险了。

say:6:1321129004:1.source_cn: 但我没想到会遇到叶角熊……还要麻烦你们来救我……

say:7:1321129005:1.text: Is the salad a local delicacy of Cedartown? Sounds yummy!

say:9:1321129007:1.text: So, I wanted to prepare it to please the goddess. It could be the key to receiving a blessing!
say:9:1321129007:1.source_cn: 所以我才想着用这道菜讨女神欢心，说不定更有可能获得祝福！

say:10:1321129008:1.text: I don't think Dura actually loves food that much...
say:10:1321129008:1.source_cn: 女神应该不会这么轻易就被美食打动吧……
